brightport_fiamma.m: I would gladly forge you something, but it would require much effort on your part. If that's alright with you.
r: There is no task beyond my skill.
Ha! You're speaking with a seasoned adventurer, I can do it!

brightport_fiamma0.m: Hey kid, you might be right about the swords, but don't ever insult my baking skills!

brightport_fiamma1.m: Unfortunately, it's not about my skill but the quality of the steel. If I had the materials, I could forge good swords all day.
r: If I brought you materials, could you forge me something with them?

brightport_fiamma11.m: With all these quality materials, I can forge you something magnificent enough to equal the legends. Come back to me later!

brightport_fiamma12.m: What a clear crystal! But I still need the lava rocks for fuel, and the arulir skin. Bring them to me and I can start.

brightport_fiamma13.m: Remember, I still need that red crystal to forge the blade. Bring it to me, and I can start.

brightport_fiamma14.m: It's done! but... There is a slight problem.

brightport_fiamma15.m: The sword is not done yet. Have you no patience?

brightport_fiamma16.m: I've quenched it, but when I try to pull it out of the water, it reacts to the air and starts heating up. It quickly becomes unbearable to hold.

brightport_fiamma17.m: I was hoping to keep the Arulir skin for a pair of forging gloves, but I ended up making these smaller, heat-resistant gloves, to wield this magnificent two-handed sword I crafted from the materials you brought me.
r: Two-handed sword? I thought you would make me a regular sword.

brightport_fiamma18.m: Hey, you didn't specify, so I made what I know best.
r: Could you forge me something else with the same materials then?

brightport_fiamma19.m: Frankly, I don't feel like forging another sword for you, but I can give you something else instead, and keep the sword for myself if you don't like it.
r: Sorry, I'll keep the sword instead.

brightport_fiamma2.m: All the metal we're getting now is lower quality scraps. Feygard has been deliberately interfering with the trade, creating a shortage so that blacksmiths in towns like Vilegard and ours, which were affiliated with Nor City, can't forge quality weapons. Keeping all the good ore for themselves.
r: What would you say if I brought you some quality materials?

brightport_fiamma20.m: Well, usually I would have my reservations about giving someone as young as you something this dangerous. But you're the one who fought those dangerous creatures, so my worries are unfounded. Take it, and use it well.
r: [I'll probably keep it as a trophy]

brightport_fiamma21.m: Take this glaive, it was given to me by my old master from Nor City. It was originally forged for nobility but after lord Emeric's defeat in the noble wars. The Imeria branch of house Houdart fell from grace, and this was sold for cheap at an auction.

brightport_fiamma3.m: OK. First, we have to discuss the materials I have in mind. I presume you have heard of the town of Remgard?
r: Yes I have heard of it.

brightport_fiamma4.m: If so, then listen closely, as you are about to hear of it.

brightport_fiamma5.m: Many travelers pass through Brightport on their way to and back from Remgard. The town lies high in the mountains, and from those travelers I heard of beasts called arulirs, harassing travelers along a short stretch of the road.

brightport_fiamma6.m: But what's most interesting is their origin. The area they now inhabit was a mining camp, which was abandoned after the caves became unstable. Out of the depths, gornauds clawed a tunnel, releasing arulirs from the fiery depths they inhabited.

brightport_fiamma7.m: First, if you can travel there, I want a strip of the arulir's skin - rumored to be tougher than steel but as flexible as leather. Second, I want 15 cooled down lava rocks from inside the mountain cave. These will fuel my forge better than the brown coal.

brightport_fiamma8.m: And lastly, the material from which I will forge a blade, a red crystal from a gornaud. This material, which their teeth and claws are made of, can easily crush rock. Only in rare cases, the mineral gathers and forms crystal clusters on their body or inside them. So don't be disheartened if you seemingly can't find one. Good luck!

brightport_fiamma_rocks.m: That's good, $playername. But I still need a strip of arulir skin to go along with them.

brightport_smith.m: Greetings, my name is Fiamma. I forge my swords as finely as I bake my bread.
r: Could you show me what you have to sell?
That makes it sound like you're not a very good baker either.
I have the cold lava rocks and arulir skin.
I have the cold lava rocks.
I have the red crystal here.

brightport_fiamma.5: Fiamma, the swordsmith of Brightport. Is willing to forge me a sword if I can bring him the materials.
brightport_fiamma.10: In the mountains near the road to Remgard lies a dangerous area overrun by Arulirs, beasts with skin as tough as steel.
brightport_fiamma.15: Fiamma has asked for a strip of Arulir skin, coveted for its durability and flexibility. He also requires 15 cold lava rocks from the mountain cave, which burn hotter than any ordinary coal.
brightport_fiamma.20: The final material is a red crystal from a Gornaud, a ferocious beast that sometimes forms these rare crystals in its body.
brightport_fiamma.25: I brought Fiamma the arulir skin and lava rocks.
brightport_fiamma.30: I brought Fiamma the red crystal.
brightport_fiamma.35: I gave all the materials to Fiamma. He thanked me and told me to come back later when it's finished.
brightport_fiamma.40: To my surprise, the sword he forged heats up on contact with air and requires special gloves to handle. They are made of the Arulir skin I brought.
brightport_fiamma.45: I asked Fiamma to give me something else, and he gave me a very sharp glaive.
brightport_fiamma.50: I thanked Fiamma and went on my merry way.
